action: Place probe in the midline. Prepare to repeat the previous sweep maneuver.
interpretation: Re-establishing the starting position for a midline scan.

action: Instruct patient: 'Take a big deep breath.' Sweep the probe across to the left, then sweep back across to the right.
interpretation: Utilize the breath hold to displace abdominal organs inferiorly. Visualize midline structures in detail during the left-to-right sweep.

action: Direct probe attention specifically to the gallbladder region.
interpretation: Identifying the gallbladder for focused assessment.

action: Adjust depth knob.
interpretation: Optimizing depth specifically to frame the gallbladder, removing unnecessary posterior dead space.

action: Adjust the focal zone (focus) to the level of the gallbladder. Adjust the gain knob.
interpretation: Placing the focus at the region of interest to improve lateral resolution. Modifying gain to achieve appropriate brightness.

action: Observe the image quality following gain optimization.
interpretation: Confirm that the gallbladder lumen appears anechoic (black), indicating appropriate gain settings and lack of noise.

action: Scan the entire length of the gallbladder. Press 'Freeze' to capture the image.
interpretation: Visualize the full anatomy of the gallbladder from the fundus down to the neck.

action: Identify surrounding anatomical landmarks on the frozen image.
interpretation: Locate the porta hepatis/portal vein, the IVC (Inferior Vena Cava), and the renal artery posterior to the gallbladder.

action: Unfreeze. Orient probe for a longitudinal section, then rotate 90 degrees for a transverse section.
interpretation: Standard protocol requires assessment of the gallbladder in two orthogonal planes (long and transverse).

action: Decrease the sector width.
interpretation: Narrowing the field of view to increase frame rate and focus on the gallbladder.

action: Activate the 'Zoom' function.
interpretation: Magnifying the image to inspect the gallbladder wall and lumen detail.

action: Perform a detailed visual inspection of the gallbladder.
interpretation: Assessing for pathology with optimized zoom and focus settings.

action: Scan the gallbladder through multiple positions and angles.
interpretation: Checking for gallstones that may be hidden or impacted; looking for mobility of stones ('rolling') to confirm diagnosis.

action: Reposition probe to locate the Common Bile Duct (CBD).
interpretation: Transitioning the exam to the biliary tree.

action: Increase sector range (width) slightly. Instruct patient: 'Take a big deep breath'.
interpretation: Widening the view to catch landmarks. Inspiration moves the liver down to provide a better acoustic window for the porta hepatis.

action: Hold probe steady on the tubular structure in the porta hepatis.
interpretation: Visualizing a clear view of the Common Bile Duct (CBD).

action: Identify the structures of the portal triad and surrounding vessels.
interpretation: Differentiate the anatomy: IVC (posterior), Portal Vein, Hepatic Artery (transverse view), and the CBD running anterior/superior ('coming over the top').

action: Activate measurement calipers.
interpretation: Prepare to measure the diameter of the CBD at the visualized point.

action: Slide the probe distally to trace the CBD.
interpretation: Attempting to follow the course of the CBD downwards towards the head of the pancreas.

action: Instruct patient: 'Just take a big deep breath'.
interpretation: Using inspiration to displace bowel gas that might obscure the pancreas.

action: Maintain visualization of the distal duct.
interpretation: Observing the CBD as it courses over the top of the pancreatic head.

action: Follow the CBD caudally.
interpretation: Tracing the full path of the CBD into the pancreatic tissue.

action: Identify the surrounding tissue.
interpretation: Visualizing the head of the pancreas.

action: Confirm the extent of the scan.
interpretation: Verify visualization of the CBD from the pancreatic head proximally up to the porta hepatis.

action: Conclude the scan of the biliary duct.
interpretation: CBD assessment complete.
